name: Initial Heretic selection applies its requested Void Shield signature (#4263)
contract: ChrSpecs 40 (Heretic, internal Influence) specifies signature spell 500715 and identity entry 4042. The
native client specialization upload explicitly includes Void Shield entry 29265 rank 1. It is a paid
shared-class node (AE 1), so the expected behavior is automatic allocation of the first class point, not a
free spell or cost override. A fresh level-10 player must receive the requested signature; later
specialization switches preserve their saved builds.

steps.label: Void Shield is absent before selecting Heretic
The initial specialization upload grants its requested Void Shield
